figures.text: results released October 22, 2026 (Hypebot date Oct 22, 2026; Spotify newsroom URL 2026-10-22)
figures.quote: Spotify released its Q3 2026 subscriber and earnings report showing sustained double-digit growth while also improving profitability.

figures.text: 788 million monthly active users, up 11% year over year (both sources)
figures.quote: Monthly Active Users (MAUs) rose by 11% Y/Y to 788 million

figures.text: 11 million net new monthly users in the quarter (Hypebot)
figures.quote: 11 million net new MAUs.

figures.text: Premium subscribers up 9% to 306 million (both sources)
figures.quote: Premium Subscribers grew 9% Y/Y to 306 million

figures.text: 6 million net Premium additions in the quarter (Hypebot)
figures.quote: 6 million net premium subscriber additions during the quarter.

figures.text: ad-supported users 499 million, up 12% year over year (Hypebot; search snippet of Thurrott agrees)
figures.quote: Ad-Supported MAUs rose to 499 million.

figures.text: ad-supported growth 12% year over year
figures.quote: a 12% increase year-over-year for the ad-supported tier.

figures.text: Premium growth across every region (Spotify newsroom)
figures.quote: In Q3 2026, we grew to 306 million Premium Subscribers, with growth across every region

figures.text: total revenue up 16% year over year to 5.0 billion euros (newsroom; Hypebot: 4.969 billion euros, 16%)
figures.quote: Total Revenue increased 16% Y/Y (14% Y/Y constant currency*) to €5.0 billion

figures.text: gross margin 33.0%, a third-quarter record (Hypebot; newsroom: improved to 33.0%)
figures.quote: Gross Margin finished at a Q3 record high of 33.0%.

figures.text: stock closed the day up 11.19% (more than 11) at $583.66 (Hypebot only)
figures.quote: Spotify [SPOT] closed the day at $583.66 up 11.19%

figures.text: Hypebot: sustained double-digit growth (more than 10%) while improving profitability
figures.quote: showing sustained double-digit growth while also improving profitability.

figures.text: Hypebot: results prove scaling profitability without sacrificing audience growth
figures.quote: successfully code on scaling profitability without sacrificing audience growth.

figures.text: Alex Norström, Co-CEO: did what we said
figures.quote: This was a quarter where we did what we said.

figures.text: Norström: continue to grow and take share
figures.quote: That’s why we continue to grow and take share.

figures.text: Gustav Söderström, Co-CEO: Spotify stands to thrive in the agentic age
figures.quote: Spotify is in one of the few categories that actually stands to thrive in the agentic age.

figures.text: Söderström: agents take care of things people would rather not do; nobody asks an agent to summarize a song
figures.quote: agents excel at replacing and taking care of things people would rather not do.

figures.text: Söderström quote
figures.quote: Nobody asks an agent to “summarize a song” for them.

figures.text: Creator Memberships rolling out in 34 markets for eligible creators (both sources)
figures.quote: Memberships are now rolling out in 34 markets, giving eligible creators a new way to offer exclusive content

figures.text: Spotify Partner Program to more than 35 new markets incl. Brazil, Mexico, Italy, Spain; earnings based on engagement (both sources)
figures.quote: This expansion gives podcast creators in countries like Brazil, Mexico, Italy, and Spain new opportunities to earn revenue based on engagement.

figures.text: Taste Profile beta for Premium users 18 and older in the U.S.; shows how Spotify understands taste in music, podcasts, audiobooks; editable (both sources)
figures.quote: It’s now available to Premium Subscribers ages 18 and older in the U.S.

figures.text: Taste Profile is editable (Hypebot)
figures.quote: giving users an editable view of how the platform understands their taste.

figures.text: audiobooks from 22 markets to more than 180 by end of 2026 (both sources)
figures.quote: From now through the end of 2026, we’re expanding audiobook access from 22 markets to more than 180.

figures.text: Fresh Finds Forward: about 10,000 emerging independent artists each year (newsroom only)
figures.quote: Our new Fresh Finds Forward program will give approximately 10,000 emerging independent artists each year the resources

figures.text: Coach Live Your Story campaign, Tabby Tour at college campuses in U.S., U.K., Japan, South Korea (newsroom only)
figures.quote: The tour is making stops at college campuses across the U.S., U.K., Japan, and South Korea.
